demoTour.step1Body: Every row is a person, every column a day. Click any empty cell to add a shift, or drag a shift to move it.
demoTour.step2Body: Shifts stay private drafts until you roll them out. Then your staff get notified — and only then.
demoTour.step3Body: When someone can't make a shift they request cover here, and you approve or deny it. Same for time off.
demoTour.step4Body: Everything here is yours to break — it's a sandbox. Open My Shifts to see what your staff see.
